2- The virtue of the days of Friday and ʿArafah.

3- Explanation of what believers are tested with in this life, and that they endure, so their reward is Paradise.

4- Encouragement and warning through mention of the recompense of the disbelievers and of the righteous believers.

Commentary of al-Jaza'iri (Aysar al-Tafasir) on surah 85, verses 12–22:

Explanation of the words:

"Indeed, the seizing of your Lord is severe": that is, His seizing (akhdh) is severe when He seizes the disbelievers.

"He originates and repeats": that is, He originates creation and repeats it after its annihilation, and He originates the punishment and repeats it.

"The Forgiving, the Loving": that is, toward the sins of His believing servants, and He is affectionate (mutawaddid) toward His friends (awliya').

"Lord of the Throne, the Glorious": that is, the Possessor of the Throne, since He is its Creator and Owner; and "al-Majid" means the One deserving of perfect attributes of exaltedness.

"In denial": that is, by what was mentioned in the context of the preceding verses.

"And Allah encompasses them from behind": that is, they are within His grasp, under His authority and subjugation.

"A glorious Qur'an": that is, noble and great.

"In a preserved tablet": that is, protected from the devils; and what is meant is the Preserved Tablet (al-lawh al-mahfuz).

Meaning of the verses:

When Allah, exalted is He, mentioned what He threatened for those who tormented the believing men and women because of their faith, He informed His Messenger, addressing the idolaters of his people and their tyrants who harmed the believers in Makkah because of their faith, saying: ﴿Indeed, the seizing of your Lord is severe﴾, that is, when He seizes, His seizing is painful and severe. He proved this by saying: ﴿Indeed, it is He who originates and repeats﴾, so the One capable of origination and repetition has severe seizing. And His saying ﴿originates﴾ means He originates creation and then repeats it; He also originates punishment and then repeats it. ﴿And He is the Forgiving, the Loving﴾: so He is able to seize His enemies, and He is the Forgiver of the sins of His friends. ﴿Lord of the Throne, the Glorious﴾: that is, the Possessor of the Throne in creation and dominion, the Glorious, the Mighty, the Noble. ﴿Doer of what He intends﴾, since Allah, exalted is He, is not compelled to anything and no one can compel Him.

And His saying, exalted is He: ﴿Has there reached you the report of the hosts: Pharaoh and Thamud?﴾ — how Allah destroyed them when they transgressed, rebelled, disbelieved and disobeyed. Yes, it has reached you, and you have recited it to your disbelieving people, and they did not benefit from it, because they live in a denial that encompasses them and from which they do not leave, since it is a denial arising from arrogance, envy and ignorance; therefore they have not yet believed. And His saying, exalted is He: ﴿And Allah is encompassing them from behind﴾, that is, they are within His grasp and under His subjugation and authority; nothing of them is hidden from Him, and nothing prevents Him from them whenever He wishes to seize them. He said: it is not as they claimed and asserted; rather, it is a glorious Qur'an in a preserved tablet, protected from the devils, so neither they nor any other of all creation may touch or approach it.

Guidance from the verses:

1- The threat to wrongdoers of punishment, as retribution in this world and in the Hereafter.

2- That Allah, out of His generosity, shows affection (yatawaddad) to His friends among His servants.

3- The benefit of narratives is admonition that reaches the servant so that he neglects no duty and does not approach what is forbidden.

4- Clarification of Allah's encompassing of His servants, and that they are in His grasp and under His authority.

5- The nobility of the Noble Qur'an, and the affirmation and establishment of the Preserved Tablet.
